modus-wc-accordion.description:
A customizable accordion component used for showing and hiding related groups of content.

The component supports a `<slot>` called 'content' for injecting `<modus-wc-collapse>` elements. See [Collapse](/docs/components-collapse--docs) docs for additional info.

properties.description: Reference to the host element

properties.name: custom-class

modus-wc-autocomplete.description:
A customizable autocomplete component used to create searchable text inputs.

The component supports a `<slot>` for injecting custom content.

properties.name: el
properties.description: Reference to the host element

properties.name: auto-complete
properties.description: Hint for form autofill feature.

properties.name: bordered
properties.description: Indicates that the autocomplete should have a border.

properties.name: custom-blur
properties.description: Custom blur handler - if provided, overrides default blur behavior

properties.name: custom-class
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to host element.

properties.name: custom-input-change
properties.description: Custom input change handler - if provided, overrides default search filtering

properties.name: custom-item-select
properties.description: Custom item selection handler - if provided, overrides default selection logic

properties.name: custom-key-down
properties.description: Custom key down handler - if provided, overrides default keyboard navigation

properties.name: debounce-ms
properties.description:
The debounce timeout in milliseconds.
Set to 0 to disable debouncing.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Whether the form control is disabled.

properties.name: feedback
properties.description: Feedback state for the input field.

properties.name: include-clear
properties.description: Show the clear button within the input field.

properties.name: include-search
properties.description: Show the search icon within the input field.

properties.name: input-id
properties.description: The ID of the input element.

properties.name: input-tab-index
properties.description: Determine the control's relative ordering for sequential focus navigation (typically with the Tab key).

properties.name: items
properties.description:
The items to display in the menu.
Creating a new array of items will ensure proper component re-render.

properties.name: label
properties.description: The text to display within the label.

properties.name: leave-menu-open
properties.description: Whether the menu should remain open after an item is selected.

properties.name: max-chips
properties.description: Maximum number of chips to display. When exceeded, shows expand/collapse button. Set to -1 to disable limit.

properties.name: min-chars
properties.description: The minimum number of characters required to render the menu.

properties.name: min-input-width
properties.description: Minimum width for the text input in pixels. When chips would make input smaller, container height increases instead.

properties.name: multi-select
properties.description: Whether the input allows multiple items to be selected.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name of the form control. Submitted with the form as part of a name/value pair.

properties.name: no-results
properties.description: The content to display when no results are found.
properties.default: { ariaLabel: 'No results found', label: 'No results found', subLabel: 'Check spelling or try a different keyword', }

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Text that appears in the form control when it has no value set.

properties.name: read-only
properties.description: Whether the value is editable.

properties.name: required
properties.description: A value is required for the form to be submittable.

properties.name: show-menu-on-focus
properties.description: Whether to show the menu whenever the input has focus, regardless of input value.

properties.name: show-spinner
properties.description: A spinner that appears when set to true

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size of the autocomplete (input and menu).

properties.name: value
properties.description: The value of the control.

When no image is provided, the component can display initials (up to 3 characters) from the initials prop.

modus-wc-collapse.description:
A customizable collapse component used for showing and hiding content.

The component supports a 'header' and 'content' `<slot>` for injecting custom HTML.

properties.name: bordered
properties.description: When true, renders a border-bottom on the collapse component.

properties.name: chevron-position
properties.description: Controls chevron placement.

properties.name: collapse-id
properties.description: A unique identifier used to set the id attributes of various elements.

properties.name: custom-class

properties.name: options

Configuration options for rendering the pre-laid out collapse component.

modus-wc-content-tree.description:
A data-driven, stateless/controlled tree component. The consuming application
owns the `nodes` data (the single source of truth) and the controlled
`selectedNodeId` / `expandedNodeIds` state. The component renders the tree and
emits `nodeSelect` / `nodeExpandChange`; the application decides whether to
apply the change and passes the updated state back in.

properties.name: el
properties.description: Reference to the host element

properties.name: allow-drag-drop
properties.description: Enables drag-and-drop reordering and reparenting via a per-row drag handle (shown on hover). After a successful drop the component emits `nodeMove` on `dragend`; the application applies it (e.g. via `moveNodeRelative`) and passes updated `nodes` back in.

properties.name: bordered
properties.description: Indicates that the content tree should have a border.

properties.name: checked-node-ids
properties.description: The ids of the checked leaf nodes (multi-select). Controlled by the consuming application.

properties.name: custom-class
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the host element.

properties.name: editing-node-id
properties.description: The id of the node currently rendered as an inline editable input. Controlled by the consuming application (typically set in response to `nodeEdit`, `nodeAdd`, or `nodeDuplicate`).

properties.name: expanded-node-ids
properties.description: The ids of the currently expanded nodes. Controlled by the consuming application.

properties.name: filter
properties.description: When set, only nodes whose label matches (and their ancestors) are shown. Matching is a case-insensitive substring; matched parents reveal their full subtree. When `searchable` is enabled, this only seeds the built-in search box's initial value.

properties.name: nodes
properties.description: The tree data. The single source of truth, owned by the consuming application.

properties.name: searchable
properties.description: Shows a built-in search box above the tree that filters nodes internally (self-managed). When enabled, the search box owns the active filter and the `filter` prop is used only to seed its initial value.

properties.name: selected-node-id
properties.description: The id of the currently selected (active) node. Controlled by the consuming application.

properties.name: selection-mode
properties.description: The selection mode of the content tree.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size of the content tree items.

properties.name: toolbar
properties.description: Configures the optional toolbar rendered above the tree. When set, a toolbar is shown with the enabled controls: an expand-all / collapse-all toggle and a delete button (enabled only when nodes are checked in multi-select).

modus-wc-date.description:
A customizable date picker component used to create date inputs.

Adheres to WCAG 2.2 standards.

properties.name: el
properties.description: Reference to the host element

properties.name: bordered
properties.description: Indicates that the input should have a border.

properties.name: custom-class
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the input.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Whether the form control is disabled.

properties.name: end-value
properties.description: The end date in range mode (`type="range"`). Must match the `format` prop pattern (or the locale-derived format when unset) or ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Empty string when unset. Ignored in single mode.

properties.name: feedback
properties.description: Feedback to render below the input.

properties.name: format
properties.description: The date format for display and input.

properties.name: hide-overflow-dates
properties.description: When omitted, defaults to `true` in range mode and `false` in single mode.

properties.name: input-id
properties.description: The ID of the start input in single mode. In range mode, the end input id is `{inputId}-end` (or `{generated-id}-end` when omitted). There is no separate prop for the end input id.

properties.name: input-tab-index
properties.description: Determine the control's relative ordering for sequential focus navigation (typically with the Tab key).

properties.name: label
properties.description: The text to display within the label.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Maximum date value. Must match the `format` prop pattern (or the locale-derived format when unset) or ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

properties.name: min
properties.description: Minimum date value. Must match the `format` prop pattern (or the locale-derived format when unset) or ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name of the form control. In range mode, the end input name is `{name}-end`. There is no separate prop for the end input name.

properties.name: read-only
properties.description: Whether the value is editable.

properties.name: required
properties.description: A value is required or must be checked for the form to be submittable.

properties.name: show-week-numbers
properties.description: Displays ISO 8601 week numbers in the calendar. Week numbers are calculated with Monday as the first day of the week.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size of the input.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Activates range mode. `value` is the start date; `endValue` is the end date.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The selected date in single mode. In range mode (`type="range"`), the start date of the range. Must match the `format` prop pattern (or the locale-derived format when unset) or ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Empty string when unset.

properties.name: week-start-day
properties.description: The first day of the week for the calendar display

Use the contentElement prop to supply rich HTML content to the tooltip such as multiline text.
For plain dynamic text, prefer the content prop instead. When contentElement is set, it takes precedence over the content prop.

For screen reader support, set `tooltip-id` on this component and matching `aria-describedby`
on the trigger (e.g. modus-wc-button).
